metadata.description: Windows (MSI) internal-app create, live-captured via the real ChunkedUploader (chunked upload + CreateInternalApplication) against the configured test org group on the 26.2.0.0 test tenant, 2026-07-30. WIRED IN: internal/mockserver's ChunkHandler.handleInternalApplication now selects this fixture when the create request's file_name ends in .msi (selectInternalApplicationFixture in chunk_handler.go), instead of always serving the shared internal-application-response.json fixture regardless of request content -- same mechanism documented on internal_app_create_apk.json's sibling fixture. See TestChunkHandler_InternalApplication_MsiFileName_ServesMsiFixture. EMPIRICAL REQUIRED-FIELD FINDINGS for .msi specifically (in addition to the file_name and supported_models findings shared with apk, documented on the apk fixture): (1) 'Deployment options WhenToInstall, HowToInstall, WhenToCallInstallComplete cannot be null or empty, if Software Distribution feature is enabled and application file types are .zip, .exe and .msi' -- fixed by supplying deployment_options with all three non-nil (their own inner fields could stay empty/default; only presence of the three sub-objects was required). (2) 'SupportedProcessorArchitecture cannot be null or empty when Software Distribution feature is enabled. Supported types: x86, x64, ARM64, ARM' -- fixed by supplying supported_processor_architecture ('x64' used here, matching the real 7z2409-x64.msi binary). REAL-WIRE FINDING: same PushMode string-vs-wire-number defect documented on the apk fixture reproduces identically here (Platform differs, 12=WinRT vs 5=Android, but PushMode is again a JSON number 0 against a string-typed field) -- confirms the defect is general to InternalApplicationEntityV1, not apk-specific. SEPARATE REAL-WIRE FINDING: bundle_id was not supplied by the caller for this platform (MSI create commonly omits BundleID per the runbook's own guidance) and the server returned a real installer GUID as the BundleId, not tenant- or environment-specific data (see the private ledger, tests/verified-endpoints.json, for provenance).
